questions.prompt: How will the component ingest the Audio Overviews?
questions.description: Audio overviews are audio files. Do we need a transcription step, or will we intercept the intermediate text generation traces from the TTS pipeline?

options.label: Transcribe the generated audio back to text
Intercept text transcripts before TTS generation

questions.prompt: How should the SIFT protocol map to NotebookLM sources?
questions.description: SIFT usually involves external web search, but NotebookLM is grounded in user-provided documents.

options.label: Trace claims exclusively against provided notebook sources
Include external web search to verify claims not found in sources

questions.prompt: How should we apply the SFL pipeline to the two-host 'banter' format?
questions.description: Referencing sfl-engine, we can track tenor/modality shifts between speakers to see if 'banter' correlates with hallucinations.

options.label: Build speaker profiles and track shifts between the two hosts
Flag semantic anomalies where banter drifts from source material

questions.prompt: What should the final report output look like?
questions.description: What actions should the user be able to take based on the fact-checking report?

options.label: A detailed Markdown report with inline citations and data quality warnings (similar to sfl-engine)
Structured JSON data for programmatic consumption
